derivations.value: Corporation Tax > Goods and Services Tax > Taxes on Income other than Corporation Tax > Union Excise Duties
derivations.reasoning: In the 2019-20 Budget Estimates corporation tax was the largest single head (about Rs 7.66 lakh crore), followed by the Centre's share of GST (about Rs 6.63 lakh crore), then personal income tax (about Rs 5.69 lakh crore), with Union excise duties smallest (about Rs 3 lakh crore); since all four are scaled by the same GDP, the rupee order is also the order as a percentage of GDP.

India's overall Ease of Doing Business rank rose sharply on the back of gains in getting electricity, starting a business and paying taxes, but its rank on registering property actually slipped over the same period, from about 121 to about 154, because the underlying registration process was largely unreformed.

derivations.value: The claim that the Act is not being implemented in all States/UTs is false — it has covered all 36 States and Union Territories since November 2016
derivations.reasoning: The National Food Security Act was passed in 2013 and covers about two-thirds of the population (75 per cent rural and 50 per cent urban), but its roll-out was completed in November 2016, since when it has been in force in every State and Union Territory, so the statement that it is not implemented everywhere is the incorrect one.

derivations.value: The claim that the fiscal deficit stayed at the Budget Estimate level is false — it overshot the 3.3 per cent target
derivations.reasoning: In 2019-20 growth decelerated, tax revenue fell well short of the Budget Estimates and non-tax revenue rose sharply on the back of the large RBI surplus transfer; consequently the fiscal deficit could not be held at the budgeted 3.3 per cent of GDP and was revised upward, so the statement that it matched the Budget Estimates is wrong.

Food subsidy was budgeted at roughly Rs 1.84 lakh crore for 2019-20, more than twice the total fertilizer subsidy of about Rs 80,000 crore (of which urea is only a part) and several times the petroleum subsidy, making it the single largest major subsidy.

Leh lies in the rain-shadow of the Great Himalayas and is a cold desert receiving only about 100 mm of precipitation a year, far less than Jodhpur in the Thar margin (about 350 mm), Delhi (about 790 mm) or Bengaluru (about 900 mm).

The tundra lies beyond the tree line, where the short growing season and permanently frozen subsoil prevent trees from establishing, so its vegetation is limited to mosses, lichens and low shrubs and yields no timber.

derivations.value: 1971 — the decade 1961-71, with a decadal growth of about 24.8 per cent
derivations.reasoning: India's decadal population growth peaked in the census decade 1961-71 at about 24.8 per cent, marginally above the 24.66 per cent of 1971-81, after which the rate declined steadily to 17.7 per cent in 2001-11.

In January the January isotherm of 20 °C runs roughly east-west near the Tropic of Cancer, separating a cooler northern India from a warmer peninsular south and so dividing the country into two nearly equal halves.

In the Koeppen scheme A denotes a tropical climate and the suffix w a dry winter, so Aw is the tropical savannah type; Am is tropical monsoon, Cwg the dry-winter subtropical type and Dfc a subarctic continental type.

In the soil-taxonomy classification of Indian soils, Inceptisols — young soils with only weakly developed horizons, occupying much of the Indo-Gangetic plain — cover the largest share of the country's area at roughly 40 per cent, ahead of Entisols at about a quarter.
Singapore lies at about 1.3 degrees North, closer to the Equator than Mogadishu at about 2 degrees North, Colombo at about 6.9 degrees North and Manila at about 14.6 degrees North.

derivations.value: All three — Annie Besant, Sarojini Naidu and Herabai Tata
derivations.reasoning: A deputation of Indian women travelled to London in 1919 and all three testified before the Joint Select Committee on the Government of India Bill in support of extending the franchise to women, Herabai Tata appearing along with her daughter Mithan.

derivations.value: Gurdaspur — the town of Qadian in Gurdaspur district, Punjab
derivations.reasoning: Mirza Ghulam Ahmad founded the Ahmadiyya movement in 1889 at his native town of Qadian, which lies in the Gurdaspur district of Punjab, and the sect's followers are accordingly also called Qadianis.

For the Holwell Monument satyagraha of 1940 Subhas Chandra Bose set aside his differences with the Muslim League and worked with it, the monument commemorating the Black Hole of Calcutta being an anti-colonial rather than a communal target.

The All India Trade Union Congress was set up in Bombay in 1920 largely on the initiative of N. M. Joshi, with Lala Lajpat Rai as its first president; B. P. Wadia's contribution had been the earlier Madras Labour Union.

The Madras Labour Union, organised by B. P. Wadia among the workers of the Buckingham and Carnatic Mills in 1918, is regarded as India's first trade union in the modern sense, with a formal membership and organisation rather than an ad hoc strike committee.

The Seva Samiti Boy Scouts Association was organised at Allahabad by Pandit Shri Ram Bajpai as an Indian alternative to the official Boy Scouts, which then excluded Indian boys; the parent Seva Samiti itself is associated with Hriday Nath Kunzru.

derivations.value: The claim that the Secretary General works under the Speaker with delegated authority is the incorrect one
derivations.reasoning: The Secretary General of the Lok Sabha advises the Speaker and issues orders and communications in the Speaker's name and under the Speaker's authority, but the Speaker's authority is personal and is not delegated to him, so describing his position as one of delegated authority is inaccurate.

The motion for the first secret sitting of the Central Legislative Assembly, held in 1942 to allow a frank discussion of the war situation, was moved by M. S. Aney, then a senior member associated with the Government's side of the House.

derivations.value: The claim that the President resigns by writing to the Speaker of the Lok Sabha is false — the resignation is addressed to the Vice-President
derivations.reasoning: Article 56 fixes the President's term at five years, allows removal by impeachment and continuation in office until a successor takes over, but it requires a resignation to be addressed in writing to the Vice-President, not to the Speaker.

Articles 31A and 31C expressly save laws for the acquisition of estates and laws giving effect to certain Directive Principles from challenge on the ground of inconsistency with Articles 14 and 19; Article 31B protects Ninth Schedule laws against all the fundamental rights rather than these two alone, and Article 31D has been repealed.

derivations.value: The requirement that the office must NOT be a substantive one — in fact it must be substantive
derivations.reasoning: Quo warranto lies only where the office is public, is created by statute or by the Constitution, is of a substantive character and has been occupied in contravention of the law; the condition is therefore that the office must be substantive, so its negation is not a requirement at all.

derivations.value: The National Commission for Scheduled Tribes
derivations.reasoning: The 89th Amendment split the earlier joint commission, leaving Article 338 for the National Commission for Scheduled Castes and inserting Article 338A to establish a separate National Commission for Scheduled Tribes.
The United Nations observes 12 August as International Youth Day; World Environment Day falls on 5 June, World No-Tobacco Day on 31 May and the day against drug abuse on 26 June.

Cyclone names in the North Indian Ocean are drawn in rotation from lists contributed by the member countries, and Nisarga, which crossed the Maharashtra coast in June 2020, came from the list submitted by Bangladesh.
The 2020 biopic Shakuntala Devi, on the life of the mental calculator known as the human computer, had Vidya Balan in the title role.

G. C. Murmu was the first Lieutenant Governor of the Union Territory of Jammu and Kashmir after its reorganisation in October 2019, and resigned that office in August 2020 to be appointed Comptroller and Auditor General of India.
The Khelo India Youth Games were held at Delhi, Pune and Guwahati in their first three editions, and the fourth was allotted to Haryana, with Panchkula as the principal venue.
Kyushu is one of Japan's four main islands and is of volcanic and continental origin, whereas the Great Barrier Reef, Fiji's Rainbow Reef and Swaraj Island in the Andamans are all coral formations.

The United States is India's largest export destination and buys far more from India than it sells to it, so India has run a steady merchandise trade surplus with it; trade with China, Saudi Arabia and Germany has consistently been in deficit because of imports of manufactures and crude oil.

derivations.value: Germany, then USA, then South Africa, then India
derivations.reasoning: In the Human Development Report of 2019 Germany stood fourth in the world with an HDI of about 0.94 and the United States fifteenth at about 0.92, both in the very high human development group, while South Africa was around rank 113 and India around rank 129 with an HDI of about 0.65.

In the use-based classification of the Index of Industrial Production, primary goods carry the largest weight at about 34 per cent, well ahead of intermediate goods at about 17 per cent, consumer non-durables at about 15 per cent and consumer durables at about 13 per cent.

derivations.value: A fall in the commodity's own price — that causes movement along the curve, not a shift of it
derivations.reasoning: A demand curve is drawn for given income, tastes, population and prices of related goods, with quantity plotted against the good's own price; a change in that own price therefore produces a movement along the existing curve, while changes in income, population or tastes shift the whole curve.

Large numbers of buyers and sellers, a homogeneous product and a perfectly elastic demand curve facing each firm together mean every firm is a price taker, which is the definition of perfect competition.

derivations.value: The claim that 16 November is the ozone day is false — the International Day for the Preservation of the Ozone Layer is 16 September
derivations.reasoning: The United Nations observes 16 September as the International Day for the Preservation of the Ozone Layer, marking the signing of the Montreal Protocol on that date in 1987; the other statements, that ozone is a triatomic form of oxygen formed by photochemical reactions high in the atmosphere, are accurate.
The Sea of Azov is a shallow northern extension of the Black Sea, joined to it by the narrow Strait of Kerch between the Crimean and Taman peninsulas.

derivations.value: USA — the Climax mine in Colorado
derivations.reasoning: The Climax mine lies near Fremont Pass in the Colorado Rockies in the United States and was for decades the world's leading source of molybdenum, at one time supplying the bulk of global output.

Lakshadweep's scattered coral islands total only about 32 square kilometres, making it the smallest Union Territory, against roughly 114 for Chandigarh, 490 for Puducherry and 600 for the merged Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu.

derivations.value: River Plate, the Rio de la Plata
derivations.reasoning: The Rio de la Plata, the funnel-shaped estuary of the Parana and Uruguay rivers, separates Argentina from Uruguay, with Buenos Aires on its southern shore and Montevideo on its northern shore.
The Great Barrier Reef, the world's largest barrier reef system, stretches for over 2,000 kilometres in the Coral Sea off the Queensland coast on Australia's north-eastern side.

derivations.value: G. H. Deshmukh, Gopal Hari Deshmukh 'Lokahitawadi'
derivations.reasoning: Gopal Hari Deshmukh, who wrote under the pen name Lokahitawadi, published his hundred letters known as the Shatapatre in the Marathi weekly Prabhakar, attacking caste orthodoxy and calling for social reform.

The early Congress moderates asked for limited, gradual concessions — repeal of the Arms Act, Indianisation of the higher ranks of the army and services, and extension of the Permanent Settlement — but universal adult franchise was a demand of the later national movement, not of the moderates.

Theodore Beck, the English principal of the Mohammedan Anglo-Oriental College at Aligarh, organised the Mohammedan Anglo-Oriental Defence Association of Upper India in 1893 to keep educated Muslims loyal to the Raj and away from the Congress.
The Triveni Sangh in Bihar was an alliance of three intermediate peasant castes — Ahirs or Yadavs, Kurmis and Koeris — formed to press their claims against the upper-caste landholding groups.

S. B. Tambe, a Swarajist leader of the Central Provinces, accepted office under the Governor in October 1925, and the controversy that followed split the Swaraj Party, with the Responsivists led by Jayakar, Moonje and Kelkar defending his action.

derivations.value: T. B. Sapru and M. R. Jayakar

R. Jayakar, Surendranath Banerjea and Srinivasa Sastri; C. R. Das by contrast belonged to the Swarajist wing of the Congress.

The National Disaster Management Authority, set up under the Disaster Management Act of 2005 and chaired by the Prime Minister, is administratively placed under the Ministry of Home Affairs, which handles disaster management for the Union Government.

Ram Manohar Lohia framed the doctrine of Sapta Kranti, seven simultaneous revolutions against inequalities of sex, caste, colour, colonial rule, economic status, private property in weapons and restrictions on individual liberty.

derivations.value: The claim that a State must be democratic in order to be secular
derivations.reasoning: Secularism concerns the relation between the State and religion — rejecting theocracy, keeping the State separate from religious authority and preventing religious domination — and a State can hold to that separation without being democratic, so democracy is not part of the definition of secularity.

derivations.value: The address at the commencement of the first session after each general election and of the first session of each year
derivations.reasoning: Article 176 requires the Governor to address the Legislative Assembly, or both Houses assembled together, at the commencement of the first session after each general election to the Assembly and at the commencement of the first session of each year, and it is this constitutionally required address that is called the special address.

derivations.value: The claim that reservation for Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes is unrelated to their share of the population
derivations.reasoning: Article 243D expressly requires that seats reserved for the Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes in every Panchayat bear, as nearly as may be, the same proportion to the total seats as their population bears to the total population of the Panchayat area.

derivations.value: The claim that citizen participation is essential — that belongs to developmental, not protective, democracy
derivations.reasoning: Protective democracy, in the tradition of Locke and the utilitarians, treats voting merely as a device by which citizens defend themselves against government encroachment, is content with formal political equality and sits easily with laissez-faire capitalism; the view that participation is valuable in itself belongs to the developmental model.

The Beirut port explosion of 4 August 2020 was caused by the detonation of some 2,750 tonnes of ammonium nitrate, a fertilizer and oxidiser that had been stored unsafely in a warehouse for several years.

The Serum Institute of India, Pune, was the Indian manufacturing partner for the Oxford-AstraZeneca candidate and received the Drugs Controller General's approval to conduct its Indian human trials, the vaccine later being marketed as Covishield; Bharat Biotech's trials were for the separate indigenous Covaxin.

The Ram temple at Ayodhya was designed by Chandrakant Sompura of the Gujarat family of temple architects, whose grandfather Prabhashankar Sompura had designed the Somnath temple.
The Tropic of Capricorn crosses South America through Chile, Argentina, Paraguay and Brazil, but the whole of Uruguay lies south of it, between roughly 30 and 35 degrees South.

Mount Merapi is the very active volcano of central Java in Indonesia, Sakurajima overlooks Kagoshima Bay in southern Japan, Vesuvius stands beside the Bay of Naples in Italy and Mauna Loa is the great shield volcano of the island of Hawaii.

derivations.value: The Saudi Arabian plate — the Arabian plate is a minor, not a major, plate
derivations.reasoning: The seven major plates are the Pacific, North American, South American, Eurasian, African, Indo-Australian and Antarctic plates; the Arabian plate, like the Nazca, Cocos, Philippine and Caroline plates, is classed among the minor plates.

The Challenger Deep at the southern end of the Mariana Trench in the western Pacific reaches nearly 11,000 metres and is the deepest known point of the world ocean, deeper than the Tonga, Philippine and Kermadec trenches.

Mercury, Venus, Earth and Mars are small, dense, rocky bodies formed close to the Sun where only refractory material could condense, and are therefore called the terrestrial or Earth-like planets, in contrast to the outer gas giants.

Tundra occurs poleward of the tree line along Arctic coasts, which is why Russia, Canada and the United States through Alaska all possess it, whereas Belarus is a landlocked country lying between about 51 and 56 degrees North in the mixed forest belt, far south of any tundra.

derivations.value: Cirque — a glacial, not a fluvial, landform
derivations.reasoning: A cirque is the armchair-shaped hollow excavated at the head of a valley glacier, whereas gorges, canyons and braided channels are all cut or built by running water.

Gandhara sculptors first worked in blue-grey schist and green phyllite, but from the third century CE stucco, being cheaper and quicker to model, took over completely as the medium for the great monastic complexes of the region.

derivations.value: The claim that most Gupta coins were of copper — the Guptas are known above all for their gold coinage
derivations.reasoning: The Guptas issued their coinage overwhelmingly in gold, the dinara, with silver introduced by Chandragupta II after the conquest of the Western Kshatrapas; copper issues were comparatively few, so the claim that copper coins were the most numerous is wrong.

The Philosophy of the Bomb was drafted in 1930 by Bhagwati Charan Vohra and approved by Chandrashekhar Azad, as the revolutionaries' reply to Gandhi's article The Cult of the Bomb condemning the Viceroy's train attack.

The Resolution on Fundamental Rights and Economic Policy, which committed the Congress to civil liberties, a living wage and state ownership of key industries, was adopted at the Karachi session of 1931 presided over by Vallabhbhai Patel.

Delhi under Bahadur Shah, Kanpur under Nana Saheb and Awadh including Ayodhya and Faizabad were principal seats of the rebellion, whereas at Agra the British retained control, the European community withdrawing into the fort until the revolt was suppressed.

derivations.value: Only the second statement is wrong — the Azamgarh Proclamation is a rebel document of 1857, not of 1942

Ibn Battuta reached Delhi in the reign of Muhammad bin Tughluq, who made him qazi of the capital and later despatched him as his ambassador to the Mongol court of China.

Al-Biruni, a Central Asian scholar who came to India with Mahmud of Ghazni, wrote his account of Indian sciences and society, the Kitab-ul-Hind or Tahqiq-i-Hind, in Arabic, the language of learning in the Islamic world of his day.

Parliamentary freedom of speech under Article 105 is a distinct guarantee and is not cut down by the restrictions attaching to Article 19(1)(a), while the Supreme Court has held that privileges must yield to Articles 20 to 22 and to Article 32; on the other hand freedom from arrest extends only to civil and not criminal process, and the immunity attaches only to what is said in the House or its committees, never to a member's private capacity.

derivations.value: Members are appointed or elected on a motion made and adopted, or are nominated by the Speaker or the Chairman
derivations.reasoning: Parliamentary committees are constituted in more than one way — some by election through proportional representation on a motion adopted by the House, others by nomination by the Presiding Officer — so no single method describes them all.

The Election Commission recognises parties in three categories only — national parties, State parties and registered unrecognised parties — the term regional party being a journalistic description rather than a status conferred under the Symbols Order.

The Forty-second Amendment of 1976 inserted the words socialist and secular into the description of the Republic and added integrity to the phrase on the unity of the nation; fraternity had stood in the Preamble since its adoption in 1949.
Sir Benegal Narsing Rau served as Constitutional Adviser to the Constituent Assembly and prepared the initial draft of the Constitution which the Drafting Committee under Ambedkar then worked upon.

derivations.value: The Supreme Court and the High Courts only
derivations.reasoning: Writ jurisdiction is conferred by Article 32 on the Supreme Court and by Article 226 on the High Courts; subordinate courts have no power to issue writs.

Citizenship is dealt with in Part II of the Constitution, Articles 5 to 11, the last of which empowers Parliament to regulate the acquisition and termination of citizenship, under which power the Citizenship Act and its amendments have been enacted.
A rare yellow flapshell turtle, its colouring caused by a pigment deficiency, was found in Balasore district of Odisha in July 2020 and handed over to the forest department.

ASEEM is the portal launched by the Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship in 2020 to map skilled workers against employers' demand, its name standing for Aatmanirbhar Skilled Employee Employer Mapping.

The Stay in India and Study in India initiative, aimed at retaining Indian students at home and drawing foreign students to Indian institutions, is run by the Ministry of Education, which is responsible for higher education policy.

Lonar Lake occupies a crater blasted out of the Deccan basalt by a meteorite impact, and the shock-altered minerals of its rocks closely resemble those in lunar samples, which is why it is studied as a terrestrial analogue of the Moon.
Pragyan, the rover carried by the Vikram lander of Chandrayaan-2, was a six-wheeled solar-powered vehicle designed to travel about 500 metres on the lunar surface.
Kinetic energy is related to momentum by the expression p squared divided by twice the mass, so at constant mass doubling the momentum multiplies the kinetic energy by four.
Newton's law of gravitation makes the force vary inversely as the square of the separation, so doubling the distance reduces the force by a factor of four.

derivations.value: The claim that neutrons revolve around the nucleus — it is the electrons that do so
derivations.reasoning: Neutrons are uncharged particles of almost the same mass as the proton and are bound inside the nucleus itself; it is the electrons that occupy orbitals around the nucleus.

derivations.value: The claim that ultraviolet light is a longitudinal wave — it is transverse
derivations.reasoning: Ultraviolet radiation is part of the electromagnetic spectrum, with electric and magnetic fields oscillating at right angles to the direction of travel, so it is a transverse wave that needs no medium and has a shorter wavelength than visible light.

derivations.value: The speed of light in air divided by the speed in the medium
derivations.reasoning: The absolute refractive index of a medium is defined as the ratio of the speed of light in air or vacuum to its speed in that medium, a quantity always greater than one because light slows on entering a denser medium.
Algae are chlorophyll-bearing, simple, thalloid autotrophs that are largely aquatic in both fresh and marine water, whereas bryophytes, pteridophytes and gymnosperms are land plants.

The species is the basic taxonomic category, grouping together all individuals that share fundamental similarities and can interbreed; a genus groups related species, and family and order are progressively wider categories.
A pearl is formed inside the mantle of a pearl oyster, which deposits successive layers of nacre around a foreign particle that has lodged within its shell.

Analogous organs perform the same function but are built on different plans and have separate evolutionary origins; a bird's wing is supported by feathers on a modified forelimb while a bat's is a skin membrane stretched over elongated fingers, yet both serve for flight.
Helicobacter pylori colonises the mucous lining of the stomach and duodenum and damages it, and its discovery as a cause of peptic ulcers earned Marshall and Warren the Nobel Prize.
Ammonium chloride sublimes on heating, passing directly from solid to vapour and condensing on a cool surface, while sodium chloride does not, so gentle heating separates the two.

Dalton was the first to use symbols to stand for the elements, each symbol also denoting a definite quantity — one atom — of that element. The one- and two-letter notation actually in use today (H, O, Na) is the later proposal of Berzelius, so a reader taking 'symbol of element' to mean the modern symbol would answer Berzelius instead; the stem does not say which it means. Dalton is taken as the answer because the stem's verb is 'introduced', i.e. first used, which is how the standard Class 9 treatment words Dalton's contribution while crediting Berzelius separately with the letter form.

Bromine and mercury are the only two elements that are liquid at ordinary room temperature and pressure; fluorine is a gas, thallium a solid metal, and rubidium melts only a little above room temperature at about 39 degrees Celsius.
Zinc oxide is amphoteric, dissolving in acids to give zinc salts and in alkalis to give zincates, whereas magnesium and calcium oxides are purely basic.
Silver reacts with traces of hydrogen sulphide in the air to form a thin surface layer of black silver sulphide, which is why silverware tarnishes rather than rusting.

The power of a lens measures its converging or diverging ability, so the greater the magnitude of the power the shorter the focal length and the more sharply the lens deviates a ray; 2.5 dioptre is the largest magnitude among the four.

The object lies between the focus and twice the focal length of the converging lens, since 40 cm falls between 25 cm and 50 cm, so the image formed beyond twice the focal length on the far side is real, inverted and larger than the object.

A ray striking the surface along the normal has zero angle of incidence, and by Snell's law the sine of the refracted angle is then also zero, so the ray passes into the second medium without bending, merely changing speed.

derivations.value: Thunderstorm — lightning is seen before the thunder is heard
derivations.reasoning: Lightning and thunder are produced at the same instant, yet the flash is seen well before the sound arrives, which shows directly that light travels far faster than sound through the air.

derivations.value: A point source with an opaque screen
derivations.reasoning: An extended source lights the edge of an obstacle from many directions and so surrounds the shadow with a partly lit penumbra, whereas a point source produces only a full umbra with a sharp boundary, and the shadow must fall on an opaque surface to be seen.
Solar energy is renewable and is classed as a non-conventional source, while coal, petroleum and nuclear fuels are exhaustible conventional sources.

derivations.value: Phloem transports the products of photosynthesis
derivations.reasoning: Phloem is a complex tissue that translocates sugars and other food made in the leaves to the rest of the plant; the conduction of water and minerals is the work of the xylem, which also provides mechanical support.

derivations.value: Lignified walls, and the cells are dead
derivations.reasoning: Sclerenchyma cells lay down thick lignified secondary walls and lose their protoplasm at maturity, so they are dead cells that serve purely to give the plant mechanical strength.

derivations.value: One X chromosome from the mother and one X chromosome from the father
derivations.reasoning: A human female has two X chromosomes, one contributed by the mother's egg, which always carries an X, and one by a sperm carrying an X; a sperm carrying a Y instead would produce a male.

Penicillin interferes with the cross-linking of peptidoglycan in the bacterial cell wall, so dividing bacteria cannot build an intact wall and burst; human cells have no such wall, which is why the drug is selectively toxic.

Tritium has one proton and two neutrons and is the only unstable isotope of hydrogen, decaying by beta emission with a half-life of about 12 years, whereas protium and deuterium are stable and hydronium is an ion, not an isotope.

Liquid nitrogen boils at about minus 196 degrees Celsius and is cheap, inert and readily available, which makes it the standard cryogen for preserving semen, embryos, blood and other biological tissue.

Silver lies very low in the reactivity series and does not combine with atmospheric oxygen, its blackening being due to sulphide formation, while magnesium, lead and tin all form oxides on exposure to oxygen.

Phosphorus has five valence electrons and can either complete an octet by sharing three, as in phosphine and phosphorus trichloride, or expand its octet using vacant d orbitals to show a valency of five, as in phosphorus pentachloride.
Lead nitrate decomposes on heating to yellow lead monoxide together with brown fumes of nitrogen dioxide and oxygen, which is the classic laboratory demonstration of a thermal decomposition reaction.
INS Viraat, the Centaur-class carrier formerly HMS Hermes, served the Indian Navy from 1987 and was decommissioned in 2017; the other vessels named are a destroyer and two submarines, not carriers.
Simona Halep of Romania won her first Wimbledon women's singles title in 2019, beating Serena Williams in straight sets in the final.
